summary: Best 28.523 (arm 2b), incumbent 28.628. The field's route past 28.6% is physically closed (asymptote ~28.75%); the WR demo (analysis only) shows the real route: a ~2,000 u dip into a cavity, a surf-ramp turnaround, a climb back level into the tunnel. New generic sampler options --respawn-novel-turn / --respawn-novel-band (+ a 3-6x sampler speed-up) put ~85% of novel rows in that dip. Bench (demo states, measurement only): after 450M steps of it the policy flies the return leg from the climb into the room 5/11 (29.9%); the entry and the ramp turn-up are still missing. Extended: r2b2_band64x to 7.2B.
